items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And this one you had George Adams, Joe Ford, Charles Fambrough, and Sonship.

ctx.x: Because Charles Fambrough earlier this year, yeah and Wilby, but I didn’t know Sonship had.

And this one you had George Adams, Joe Ford, Charles Fambrough, and Sonship. Now I bring this one up not only because it was a great album and very influential for me, but when I review your discography this one is unfortunately not listed. Well it’s in there but it’s listed as 1963 so was there another album that was recorded called “The Meeting,” or “The Greeting?” That was just on your website.
